method.movement: scale the empirical 2D displacement from constant-input four-tick native windows
method.test_start: stock x=0 y=400 at Stage 1 frame 30; use first observed native replay position and tick for later stages. A separate bottom-spawn stress hypothesis initializes later stages at x=0 y=400.
method.reference: position linearly interpolated in native stage-frame time; error is always relative to true clock
method.controls: compare focus and shoot with the first recorded expert input of that decision
method.dense_boss: top quartile of recorded projectile counts within the final boss encounter
method.late_boss: last half of the final observed boss encounter
method.decision_index: one recorded row drawn per four ticks; ignores missing rows
method.alternate_actuators: use same frozen inverse map with target delta scaled to a four-tick equivalent, no resync; compare to absolute4_without_resync on identical route clock.
method.cadence_deadband: alternate offline policy ignores boss encounter reanchors smaller than one action interval; deployed candidate remains unchanged.
method.native_physics_limits: No collisions, hitstop, bombs, phase reaction, shot simulation or respawn; alternative ticks interpolate route and assume per-tick linear mechanics.
